Employee Benefits Policy
Effective Date:
Policy effective from date - 1 August 2022
Disclaimer:
The company reserves the right to alter or withdraw the policy at any point of time.
Objective:
To convey the organization’s best wishes to the employee during the important occasions intheir lives.
Scope:
The policy outlines the process of the celebrations during special occasions such asmarriage and the birth of their children.
Applicability:
The policy is applicable to all employees ofDevstringxTechnologies Ltdafter they getfull-time employment.
Policy Details:
oOn occasion of the marriage of an employee, an amount of INR 2,100/- will be givenas a gift to the employee.oOn the occasion of the birth of a baby or adoption of a child, an employee will bepresented with an amount of INR 2,100/- as a gift.oThe gift of INR 2,100/- will be applicable up to two children only.oThe amount given as a gift for the marriage or birth of a baby will be added to theemployee’s income for the purpose of taxation as applicable.oIn order to avail the marriage gift, an employee is required to share relevantinformation as per the process defined within 30 days after the event.oIn order to avail the newborn/adoption gift, a male employee is required to sharethe relevant information as per process defined within  30 days from the birth/

adoption of child and a female employee is required to share the relevant informationwithin 210 days from the birth/ adoption of child.
Process:
New born baby gift allowance:
o The new born baby allowance will be paid to the male employees who are on thepayroll of Devstringx Technologies and update the details within 30 days from theDOB of the child at the HRMS portal.o The new born baby allowance will be paid to the female employees who are on thepayroll of Devstringx Technologies and update the details within 210 days from theDOB of the child at the HRMS portal.o To update, kindly raise the ticket in the HRMS portal ofDevstringx Technologies PvtLtd.o Employees need to upload the Birth certificate or letter from the hospital asdocumentary proof.o The allowance will be paid in the subsequent month’s payroll post, getting approvedby the Workflow partner.
Marriage gift allowance:o The marriage gift allowance is paid to the employee who is on the payroll ofDevstringx Technologies Pvt Ltd and updates the details of marriage within 180 daysfrom the date of the marriage at the HRMS portal.o To update, kindly raise the ticket in the HRMS portal of Devstringx Technologies PvtLtd.o Update marital status and spouse details can be updated under the Family Detailsoption in HRMS.o Employees need to upload the marriage certificate or marriage invitation card asdocumentary proof.

o The allowance will be paid in the subsequent month’s payroll post getting approvedby the Workflow partner.
Please note: If the Workflow Partner approves the request after the 21st of theMonth, it will be paid in next month's payroll cycle.
FAQ(s)
Q: Me and my husband/wife are both working with Devstringx. Can we both avail of anew born baby gift allowance?
A: The new born baby gift allowance can be availed by both.
Q:Me and my husband/wife are both working with Devstringx.Can we both avail of amarriage gift allowance?
A: The marriage gift allowance can be availed by both.
Q: Can I avail the marriage gift allowance for my second marriage?
A: The marriage gift allowance is applicable only for the first marriage.

GYM Policy
EFFECTIVE DATE
Policy effective from date - 1 August 2022.
ELIGIBILITY
Devstringx provides a fitness center for use to all of its employees who are willing to doexercise and make themselves fit.
PROVISIONS
● The fitness center will be open five days a week, from 9:00 a.m. to 7:00 p.m.● No Food/Drink is allowed except water bottles.● Proper workout attire must be worn.● Use all the equipment properly.● Don’t drop the weights.● There is a 20-minute limit on all cardiovascular equipment (bicycles) when othersare waiting. Any sweat left on fitness equipment should be toweled off immediatelyafter use of the equipment.● Please return all its equipment to its place after its usage.● Report any damaged equipment to the management immediately. DO NOT USE IT● Management will not be responsible for any accidents or injuries.● No Horseplay, Aggressive behavior or inappropriate language.● Keep music to yourself.● Please be watchful for your belongings. Management will not be responsible for anyloss.● Turnoff lights and AC’s before leaving the room.
Note- Anyone found defacing or damaging equipment is subject to disciplinary actionand will be held financially responsible.

PRECAUTIONS
● Practicing exercise safety helps optimize the health benefits of a fitness routine.When planning an exercise program, it's important to consider factors such as ageand health history as well as personal strength and stamina.● Use proper techniques and know your body’s limit to avoid injuries.● Please contact your health care provider prior to using the facility for advice ontypes of exercises that are appropriate for you. Also contact your health careprovider for advice on when to return to exercise following any injury or illness.Start out slowly and increase workout time and intensity gradually. Make sure toinclude a proper warm-up and cool-down into your workout routine.
TIPS
● Drink Water While You're Exercising. Even if you hydrate before and after exercise,you should still be taking in fluids during your workout.● Rest Between Weight Training Sets.● Breathe When You Stretch.● If not feeling well ask for help.
DISCLAIMER:
The company reserves the right to alter or withdraw the policy at any point of time.

Standard Definitions 
1. Accident: 
An accident means sudden, unforeseen and 
involuntary event caused by external, visible and 
violent means. 
2. Any One Illness: 
Any one illness means continuous period of 
illness and includes relapse within 45 days from 
the date of last consultation with  the

taken. 
3. Ayush Treatment: 
“AYUSH treatment” refers to the medical and / or 
hospitalization treatments given under Ayurveda, 
Yoga and Naturopathy, Unani, Siddha and 
Homeopathy systems. 
4. Break in Policy: 
“Break in policy” means the period of gap that 
occurs at the end of the existing policy term / 
instalment premium due date, when the premium 
due for renewal on a given policy or instalment 
premium due is not paid on or before the premium 
renewal date or grace period. 
5. Cashless Facility: 
Cashless facility means a facility extended by 
the insurer to the insured where the payments, 
of the costs of treatment undergone by the 
insured in accordance with the policy terms and 
conditions, are directly made to the network 
provider by the insurer to the extent pre - 
authorization approved. 
6. Condition Precedent: 
Condition Precedent means a policy term or 
condition upon which the Insurer's liability under 
the policy is conditional upon. 
7. Congenital Anomaly: 
Congenital Anomaly means a  condition which is 
present since birth, and which is abnormal with 
reference to form, structure or position

Congenital anomaly which is not in the visible and 
accessible parts of the body 
b. External Congenital Anomaly 
Congenital anomaly which is in the visible and 
accessible parts of the body

Co-payment means a cost sharing requirement 
under a health insurance policy that provides that 
the policyholder/insured will bear a specified 
percentage of the admissible claims a mount. A 
co-payment does not reduce the Sum Insured.

Cumulative Bonus means any increase or 
addition in the Sum Insured granted by the insurer 
without an associated increase in premium.

practitioner AND must comply with all minimum 
criterion as under 
i) has qualified nursing staff under its employment

covered as an extension in Part I of the P olicy) 
includes the following: 
1. CANCER OF SPECIFIED SEVERITY 
I.  A malignant tumor characterized by the 
uncontrolled growth and spread of malignant 
cells with invasion and destruction of normal 
tissues. This diagnosis must be supported by 
histological evidence of malignancy. The term 
cancer includes leukemia, lymphoma and 
sarcoma. 
II. The following are excluded – 
i.  All tumors which are histologically 
described as carcinoma in situ, benign, pre- 
malignant, borderline malignant, low 
malignant potential, neoplasm of un known 
behavior, or non-invasive, including but not 
limited to: Carcinoma in situ of breasts, 
Cervical dysplasia CIN-1, CIN - 2 and CIN- 
3. 
ii. Any non-melanoma skin carcinoma unless 
there is evidence of metastases to lymph 
nodes or beyond; 
iii. Malignant melanoma that has not caused 
invasion beyond the epidermis; 
iv. All tumors of the prostate unless 
histologically classified as having a 
Gleason score greater than 6 or having 
progressed to at least clinical TNM 
classification T2N0M0 
v. All Thyroid cancers histologically classified 
as T1N0M0 (TNM Classification) or below; 
vi. Chronic lymphocytic leukaemia less than 
RAI stage 3 
vii. Non-invasive papillary cancer of the 
bladder histologically described as 
TaN0M0 or of a lesser classification, 
viii. All Gastro -Intestinal Stromal Tumors 
histologically classified as T1N0M0 (TNM 
Classification) or below and with mitotic 
count of less than or equal to 5/50 HPFs; 
2. MYOCARDIAL INFARCTION 
(First Heart Attack of specific severity) 
I. The first occurrence of heart attack or myocardial 
infarction, which means the death of a portion of the 
heart muscle as a result of inadequate blood supply 
to the relevant area. The diagnosis for Myocardial 
Infarction should be evidenced by all of the following 
criteria: 
i. A history of typical clinical symptoms consistent 
with the diagnosis of acute myocardial infarction 
(For e.g. typical chest pain) 
ii. New characteristic electrocardiogram changes 
iii.  Elevation of infarction specific enzymes, 
Troponins or other specific biochemical markers. 
II. The following are excluded: 
i. Other acute Coronary Syndromes 
ii. Any type of angina pectoris 
iii. A rise in cardiac biomarkers or Troponin T or I 
in absence of overt ischemic heart disease OR 
following an intra-arterial cardiac procedure. 
3. OPEN CHEST CABG 
I.  The actual undergoing of heart surgery to 
correct blockage or narrowing in one or more 
coronary artery(s), by coronary artery bypass 
grafting done via a sternotomy (cutting through 
the breast bone) or minimally invasive keyhole 
coronary artery bypass procedures. The 
diagnosis must be supported by a coronary 
angiography and the realization of surgery has 
to be confirmed by a cardiologist. 
II. The following are excluded: 
i. Angioplasty and/or any other intra -arterial 
procedures 
4. OPEN HEART REPLACEMENT OR REPAIR OF 
HEART VALVES

surgery is to replace or repair one or more 
heart valves, as a consequence of defects in, 
abnormalities of, or disease -affected cardiac 
valve(s). The diagnosis of the valve 
abnormality must be supported by an 
echocardiography and the realization of 
surgery has to be confirmed by a specialist 
medical   practitioner.   Catheter   based

out. Diagnosis has to be confirmed by a

I. Any cerebrovascular incident producing 
permanent neurological sequelae. This 
includes infarction of brain tissue, thrombosis 
in an intracranial vessel, haemorrhage and 
embolisation from an extracranial source. 
Diagnosis has to be confirmed by a specialist 
medical practitioner and evidenced by typical 
clinical symptoms as well as typical findings in 
CT Scan or MRI of the brain. Evidence of 
permanent neurological deficit la sting for at 
least 3 months has to be produced.

findings which unequivocally confirm the 
diagnosis to be multiple sclerosis and 
ii. there must be current clinical impairment 
of motor or sensory function, which must 
have persisted for a continuous period of 
at least 6 months.

Free Look cancellation: Every insured of new health insurance policies, except for 
those policies with tenure of less than a year, shall be provided a free look period of 
30 days beginning from the date of receipt of policy document, whether received 
electronically or otherwise, to review the terms and conditions of such policy. If the 
insured cancels the policy within free look period then the insured shall be entitled to a 
refund of the premium paid subject only to a deduction of a proportionate risk premium 
for the period of cover and the expenses, if any, incurred by the insurer on medical 
examination of the insured and stamp duty charges.

(Customer Support section),call us toll-free at 1800 2666, or

Policy renewal: Except on grounds of fraud, moral hazard or 
misrepresentation or non-cooperation, renewal of your policy shall 
not be denied, provided the policy is not withdrawn. 
 
Migration: In case of migration of indemnity based health insurance policy (except 
Personal Accident and Travel Policies) with the same Insurer, the insured can transfer 
the credits gained to the extent of the Sum Insured and benefits available in the 
previous policy to the migrated policy. The Company may underwrite the proposal in 
case of migration, if the insured is not continuously covered for 36 months. 
 
Portability: 
a. The insured  has the choice to port his / her policies from one Insurer to another. An 
Insured desirous of porting his/her policy to another insurer shall apply to such insurer 
to port the entire policy along with all the members of the family, if any, at least 
30 days before, but not earlier than 60 days from the due date for renewal. 
 
b. The insured is entitled to transfer the credits gained to the extent of the sum insured 
and the benefits available in the previous policy, subject to the underwriting policy of 
the Company 
 
c. The Company shall decide and communicate on the proposal upon receipt of 
information from Existing insurer within prescribed timelines

Standard Definitions 
1. Accident: 
An accident means sudden, unforeseen and 
involuntary event caused by external, visible and 
violent means. 
2. Any One Illness: 
Any one illness means continuous period of 
illness and includes relapse within 45 days from 
the date of last consultation with  the 
Hospital/Nursing Home where treatment was 
taken. 
3. Ayush Treatment: 
“AYUSH treatment” refers to the medical and / or 
hospitalization treatments given under Ayurveda, 
Yoga and Naturopathy, Unani, Siddha and 
Homeopathy systems. 
4. Break in Policy: 
“Break in policy” means the period of gap that 
occurs at the end of the existing policy term / 
instalment premium due date, when the premium 
due for renewal on a given policy or instalment 
premium due is not paid on or before the premium 
renewal date or grace period. 
5. Cashless Facility: 
Cashless facility means a facility extended by 
the insurer to the insured where the payments, 
of the costs of treatment undergone by the 
insured in accordance with the policy terms and 
conditions, are directly made to the network 
provider by the insurer to the extent pre - 
authorization approved. 
6. Condition Precedent: 
Condition Precedent means a policy term or 
condition upon which the Insurer's liability under 
the policy is conditional upon. 
7. Congenital Anomaly: 
Congenital Anomaly means a  condition which is 
present since birth, and which is abnormal with 
reference to form, structure or position 
a. Internal Congenital Anomaly 
Congenital anomaly which is not in the visible and 
accessible parts of the body 
b. External Congenital Anomaly 
Congenital anomaly which is in the visible and 
accessible parts of the body 
8. Co-Payment: 
Co-payment means a cost sharing requirement 
under a health insurance policy that provides that 
the policyholder/insured will bear a specified 
percentage of the admissible claims a mount. A 
co-payment does not reduce the Sum Insured. 
9. Cumulative Bonus: 
Cumulative Bonus means any increase or 
addition in the Sum Insured granted by the insurer 
without an associated increase in premium. 
10. Day Care Center:

established for day care treatment of illness 
and/or injuries or a medical setup with a hospital

make these accessible to the Insurance

Centre

Leave  Policy    Effective  Date:   Policy  effective  from  date  -  2  Jan  2026   Disclaimer:   The  company  reserves  the  right  to  alter  or  withdraw  the  policy  at  any  point  of  time.   Introduction:   The  purpose  of  this  policy  is  to  ensure  that  the  employees  follow  a  work  life  balance  and  
enable
 
them
 
to
 
manage
 
any
 
personal
 
emergencies
 
that
 
may
 
arise.
  The  policy  ensures  that  leave  is  planned  and  communicated  to  managers  and  HR  in  advance  
so
 
that
 
work
 
is
 
not
 
affected.
 
Employees
 
must
 
follow
 
the
 
defined
 
procedures
 
and
 
apply
 
for
 
leave
 
through
 
the
 
HRMS
 
portal
 
in
 
a
 
timely
 
manner.
  These  policies  will  be  reviewed  and  modified  periodically.  When  using  this  policy,  please  
remember
 
that
 
while
 
we
 
have
 
attempted
 
to
 
make
 
it
 
as
 
comprehensive
 
as
 
possible,
 
there
 
might
 
arise
 
situations
 
which
 
are
 
not
 
dwelt
 
upon
 
and
 
hence
 
you
 
might
 
need
 
to
 
seek
 
assistance
 
from
 
your
 
supervisor
 
or
 
Human
 
Resources
 
(“HR”).
 
The
 
company
 
reserves
 
the
 
right
 
to
 
modify
 
this
 
policy
 
as
 
per
 
business
 
requirements.
   Leave  Accounting  Year:  The  leaves  are  accounted  on  the  basis  of  calendar  year  i.e.  January  1st  to  31st  December.   Scope:   Full-Time  Employees:  Eligible  for  all  leave  types.  
 Full-Time  Contractuals:  Eligible  for,  SL,  LWP  and  EL  only.  
 Interns:  Eligible  for  SL,  LWP  and  (Comp  Off  optional  based  on  work  needs).    

 
Responsibilities:   Direct  Managers/Leads  are  responsible  for  approving  leaves.  Leaves  should  be  granted  
based
 
on
 
the
 
employee’s
 
needs,
 
supported
 
by
 
necessary
 
documentation
 
(where
 
applicable),
 
while
 
ensuring
 
that
 
business
 
requirements
 
are
 
appropriately
 
balanced.
   HR  to  incorporate  leave  related  inputs  while  processing  payroll.   Policy  Guidelines:   a.  In  case  of  unapproved  leave,  it  will  be  marked  as  leave  without  pay  (LWP).   b.  In  case  of  emergency,  the  employee  who  could  not  apply  for  leaves  in  advance  
should
 
inform
 
his/her
 
Direct
 
Manager/Lead
 
about
 
the
 
emergency
 
before
 
11
 
AM
 
through
 
mode
 
of
 
email/phone
 
call
 
and
 
follow
 
the
 
process
 
of
 
leave
 
application
 
after
 
resuming
 
office
 
after
 
leave.
 
 c.  Leaves  can  be  taken  into  blocks  of  half  day  and  full  day  as  per  the  available  leave  
balance.
 d.  An  employee  who  has  taken  leave  without  obtaining  prior  approval,  will  be  deemed  
to
 
be
 
absent
 
from
 
work
 
without
 
permission.
 
This
 
may
 
result
 
in
 
disciplinary
 
actions.
 e.  An  employee  who  wishes  to  cancel  previously  applied  and  approved  leave/WFH  
must
 
inform
 
their
 
reporting
 
manager
 
and
 
raise
 
a
 
ticket
 
in
 
the
 
HRMS
 
portal
 
for
 
cancellation.
 f.  No  leave,  except  maternity  leave,  can  be  claimed  by  an  employee  as  a  matter  of  right.  
Granting
 
of
 
leave
 
shall
 
be
 
at
 
the
 
discretion
 
of
 
the
 
Company
 
depending
 
on
 
work
 
exigencies.
 
Further,
 
in
 
exigencies,
 
the
 
Company
 
reserves
 
its
 
right
 
to
 
call
 
the
 
employee
 
back
 
to
 
join
 
duty
 
as
 
immediately
 
as
 
possible
 
even
 
if
 
the
 
employee
 
is
 
on
 
any
 
sanctioned
 
leave.
 g.  Notwithstanding  anything  above,  if  an  employee  does  not  report  to  work  due  to  
sudden
 
sickness,
 
he/she
 
would
 
be
 
required
 
to
 
notify
 
his
 
reporting
 
manager
 
before
 
the
 
commencement
 
of
 
normal
 
business
 
hours.
 h.  If  an  employee  wishes  to  avail  any  leave  for  which  he/she  is  not  entitled,  prior  
approval
 
from
 
the
 
Direct
 
Manager
 
is
 
mandatory
 
before
 
proceeding
 
on
 
leave.
 
An
 
email
 
confirmation
 
of
 
the
 
same
 
must
 
also
 
be
 
shared
 
with
 
HR
 
for
 
record
 
and
 
update.

such
 
leaves
 
will
 
be
 
treated
 
as
 
Leave
 
Without

(LWP)
 
in
 
the
 
payroll.

1.  Purpose  
This  policy  establishes  guidelines  and  procedures  for  obtaining  visas  and  managing  
international
 
and
 
domestic
 
travel
 
for
 
employees
 
representing
 
Devstringx
 
Technologies.
 
It
 
ensures
 
compliance
 
with
 
immigration
 
laws,
 
cost
 
control,
 
employee
 
safety,
 
and
 
the
 
company’s
 
operational
 
efficiency.
 
 
2.  Scope  
This  policy  applies  to:  
●  All  full-time  and  project-based  employees  traveling  on  behalf  of  Devstringx  
Technologies.
 
 ●  Both  domestic  and  international  business  travel  for  purposes  such  as  client  
meetings,
 
project
 
assignments,
 
training,
 
conferences
 
etc.
 
 
 
3.  Responsibilities  
Employee  
●  Obtain  prior  approval  for  all  business  travel.  
 ●  Provide  accurate  personal  information  and  documentation  for  visa  processing.  
 ●  Comply  with  visa  and  immigration  regulations  of  the  host  country.  
 ●  Submit  expense  reports  and  travel  summaries  upon  return.  
 
 
 

 
 
 
Human  Resources  (HR)  /  Global  Mobility  Team  
●  Facilitate  visa  application,  documentation,  and  sponsorship.  
 
●  Maintain  records  of  employee  travel  and  visa  status.  
 ●  Provide  guidance  on  travel  requirements,  vaccinations,  and  insurance.  
 
Finance  Department  
●  Approve  and  process  travel-related  expenses  in  line  with  company  budgets.  
 ●  Manage  per  diem  allowances  and  reimbursements.  
 
Reporting  Manager  
●  Approve  business  travel  requests  based  on  project  needs  and  budget.  
 
 
4.  Visa  Policy  
●  Devstringx  Technologies  will  sponsor  visas  for  employees  traveling  abroad  for  
approved
 
business
 
purposes.
 
 ●  Employees  must:  
 
 ○  Submit  visa  appointment  documentation  requests  well  in  advance.  
 ○  Refrain  from  using  a  business  or  work  visa  for  personal  travel.  
 ●  All  visa  fees  related  to  business  travel  are  covered  by  the  company.  
 
 

 
 
 
●  Any  visa  violations  (e.g.,  overstays,  misuse)  are  the  employee’s  responsibility  
and
 
may
 
result
 
in
 
disciplinary
 
action.
 
 
 
5.  Travel  Authorization  Process  
1.  The  employee  submits  a  Travel  Request   to  the  reporting  manager  via  HRMS  
portal
 
to
 
the
 
HR
 
or
 
Finance
 
department.
 
 2.  The  manager  reviews  and  forwards  the  request  to  Finance  for  approval.  
 3.  Once  approved,  HR  assists  with  booking,  visa  documentation,  and  travel  
insurance.
 
 4.  Employee  receives  a  formal  Travel  Authorization  Letter.  
 
 
6.  Travel  Expenses  
●  Air  Travel:  
 ○  Economy  class  for  flights.  
 ○  Business  class  may  be  approved  as  per  the  requirement.  
 
●  Accommodation:  
 ○  Standard   hotels  within  the  company  budget.  
 ○  Employees  must  use  company-approved  vendors  or  travel  agencies.  
 

 
 
 
 
●  Per  Diem:  
 ○  Daily  allowance  covers  meals,  local  transport,  and  incidental  
expenses.(for
 
specific
 
reimbursements
 
contact
 
Finance
 
department)
 
 ○  Rates  depend  on  the  destination  country  and  are  reviewed  annually.  
 ●  Reimbursements:  
 ○  All  claims  must  be  submitted  within  10  business  days  of  returning.  
 ○  Original  receipts  are  required  for  all  expenses.  
 
 
7.  Health,  Safety,  and  Insurance  
●  All  employees  traveling  abroad  must  be  covered  under  company-provided  travel  
insurance.
 
 ●  Employees  should  comply  with  local  health  regulations,  including  vaccinations  if  
required.
 
 ●  In  emergencies,  employees  must  contact  the  company’s  HR  immediately.(  email  
ID:hr@devstringx.com
  
)
 
 
 
8.  Compliance  and  Data  Protection  
●  Employees  must  adhere  to  immigration  and  labor  laws  of  the  destination  country.  
 ●  Personal  and  client  data  must  be  handled  in  accordance  with  GDPR  or  
applicable
 
data
 
protection
 
laws.
 
 

 
 
 
●  Misuse  of  company-sponsored  travel  or  visa  privileges  will  result  in  disciplinary  
action,
 
up
 
to
 
and
 
including
 
termination.
 
 
  
9.  Post-Travel  Requirements  
●  Employees  must  submit:  
 ○  A  Travel  Summary  Report  (project  updates,  meeting  notes,  or  outcomes).  
 ○  All  expense  documentation  for  settlement.  
 
 
10.  Policy  Review  
This  policy  will  be  reviewed  annually  by  the  HR  and  Management  to  ensure  continued  
relevance
 
and
 
legal
 
compliance.
 
 
11.  Contact  
For  visa  or  travel-related  queries,  please  contact:  
 
📧
 
HR
 
Department:
 
hr@devstringx.com

Policy effective from date - 1 August 2022

Purpose
To state the procedures and guidelines for rewarding those employees of the company, whohelp identify and attract suitable and competent talent in order to meet our resourcerequirements at an optimum cost.
Eligibility
All employees (with exceptions mentioned below) are eligible to participate in theEmployee Referral Award Program.
Exceptions
● Members of the Human Resources Department.● Any level of management within the hiring authority of the open position.● Any employee who has resigned from the company.
Submissions
● Employees may refer individuals who fit the specifications given in job descriptionsfor vacant positions which Human Resources posts from time to time. In case theresume is already available in the data bank, the referral process will be terminatedat this stage.
● The referrer needs to fill up the employee referral form and submit it to the HRdepartment along with the resume of the candidate. The form is available at theHRMS portal.

● The employee role will be limited to the submission of the resume of the candidate.After This, the regular process of shortlisting and interviews will be applied to thereferrals also.
● The employee making the referral will not in any way be involved with the interviewof the candidate.
Referral Payment Plan
● The Employee Referral Bonus amount will be paid as per below mentioned○ L1 - No Bonus○ L2 - INR 5000○ L3 - INR 8000○ L4 - INR 10000○ L5 - INR 20000○ L6 - INR 25000○ L7 - INR 30000○ L8 - INR 35000○ L9 - INR 45000○ L10 - INR 50000
● The referral bonus will be paid, in one installment, after the referred employee hascompleted three months on the job.
Referral Programme Guidelines
● If more than one employee refers to the same candidate, the first referral will onlybe considered. The rest of the employees will be intimated of the same.
● If resumes are received from more than one source including referrals. First receivedsource will be considered. If a candidate applies in response to an advertisement orthrough a recruitment agency and is later also referred by an employee, the referralby the employee will not be considered irrespective of whether the candidate laterprefers any one route over the other.
● All referred candidates will be hired through the company's standard hiring process.
● If an employee forwards resumes carrying stamps of external recruiters, suchresumes will not be eligible for referrals.

● The HR department will intimate the employee if the referred candidate is selected.The employees are welcome to query the HR on the status of their sent candidates.
● The referral bonus payment is considered as a perquisite and will be taxedaccordingly as per the applicable tax slab.
● All resumes sent under the referral program are valid for a period of 1 month.
● Referrals Payments will not be made in the following case:
An employee who is rehired within twelve (12) months of his/herresignation/termination date.
The bonus amount and eligibility factors are subject to change based on businessneeds, as circumstances.

Introduction
The Company depends on its employees to help full fill our obligations to our customers. because absenteeism
and late reporting are disruptive, unfair to co-workers, costly, and can jeopardize our ability to meet customer
demands; employees are expected to report to work on time as scheduled.
Unsatisfactory attendance performance, which includes excessive absenteeism and/ or tardiness, may have an
adverse effect on promotional opportunities and will result in disciplinary action up to and including termination.
Security Control
Everyone will be provided with an Access Control + Identity Card, which allows you to enter the office. Kindly
make it a point to wear your Identity Cards at all times when you are in the Office. It’s compulsory not only from
the security point of view but also helps to keep track of your attendance in the office.

working hours without permission shall be liable for disciplinary action for loitering and salary shall be deducted
for the period she/ he was not found at the place of work.
Office Timings
The regular working hours begin at 10.00 AM and end at 07:00 PM during the workweek.
Flexi Time
We practice flexi time between 10:00 AM to 10:30 AM with the intention of 9 hours to be clocked-in for the day.
However, the requirements of certain positions may limit the extent to which this policy can apply.
Example: Employees reaching at 10:30 AM in the morning can leave at 7:30 PM in the evening and employees
reaching at 10:00 AM in the morning can leave at 7:00 PM in the evening.

your scheduled workday that you will be late or absent and provide the reason for that absence or tardiness. If
your supervisor is not available, you should contact the HR at the start of your scheduled workday. Non-
information will be treated as leave and will be treated accordingly
